name: Crossrope
description: Weighted jump rope fitness brand selling interchangeable weighted ropes, smart AMP handles and sets such as Get Lean and Get Fit, paired with an app offering 2,500+ jump rope workouts, aimed at home-fitness consumers.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the Crossrope affiliate program on ShareASale at 10% commission per sale with a 30-day cookie and a $50 payout threshold.

Crossrope's own partner page (fetched) is a creator partnership hub: brand guide, demo videos, B-roll and photo collections for partners, video content tips (transformations, unboxings, tutorials), and an iDev-based partner account where partners earn commission on purchases within 30 days of a click; partners submit W-9/W-8BEN forms to ap@crossrope.com for payment setup.

The partner page states Crossrope has 'over half a million happy customers', sells interchangeable weighted ropes with precision handles, and offers 2,500+ app workouts; its linked Instagram (@crossropejumpropes) is verified with ~118K followers and its TikTok (@crossrope) hosts 861 videos.
No earnings-cap statement appears anywhere on Crossrope's partner page or in the ShareASale listing, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown, not uncapped.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure fitness brand built around short-form-friendly jump rope workouts, challenges and transformations — a strong fit for fitness creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs a structured creator partnership program with its own partner hub, brand guide, B-roll, demo videos and content tips, plus 861 videos on its TikTok account.
reasons.compensation: A published 10% per-sale commission on ShareASale with a 30-day cookie; no cap statement found, so cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A public partner page on the official site plus a published partner payments email (ap@crossrope.com).
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application routes via ShareASale and the brand's direct partner program.
reasons.credibility: Established US fitness brand claiming 500K+ customers, with a verified ~118K-follower Instagram account.

name: Monoprice
description: Online electronics retailer founded in 2002 selling affordable cables, adapters, home-theater and PC gear, professional audio equipment, networking products and 3D printers under its own name and house brands.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists Monoprice.com's affiliate program on CJ Affiliate at 2% commission per sale.
Lasso's Monoprice listing corroborates a 2% per-sale commission and adds a 7-day cookie duration and $50 payout threshold.

Shopper's partnership listing describes Monoprice, Inc. as a US technology retailer specializing in cable assemblies for home theater, PC and high-technology industries, with an affiliate payout of up to 2% per sale.
No earnings-cap statement is published in either directory listing, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Broad tech-accessories catalog (cables, audio, 3D printers) that tech and desk-setup creators regularly feature, though it is a retailer rather than a creator-first brand.
reasons.ugc_evidence: No creator or ambassador program evidence found — a standard network affiliate program only.
reasons.compensation: Published rate is a low 2% per sale with a short 7-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator contact found; the only route is the CJ Affiliate network listing.
reasons.credibility: Large US electronics retailer operating since 2002 with thousands of products.

name: Branch
description: Direct-to-consumer office furniture brand selling ergonomic chairs, standing desks, modular workstations and accessories for home offices and teams, known for high average order values above $400.

evidence.summary: Branch's own affiliate program page (fetched) invites publications and voices to apply, promises an 'above average commission rate', high average order value and conversion, and a dedicated program manager; sign-up routes through CJ Affiliate (signup.cj.com link on the page). The page does not publish the exact percentage.
LinkClicky's directory lists the Branch affiliate program on CJ Affiliate at 5% commission per sale; Lasso's Branch listing independently reports 5% per sale with a 30-day cookie.

The Affiliates List describes Branch as a DTC brand designing modern ergonomic office furniture for home workspaces and corporate teams, with average order values exceeding $400 and team orders reaching thousands of dollars, joined via CJ Affiliate at 5%.
Branch's own page makes no earnings-cap statement, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Home-office furniture is a staple of desk-setup, WFH and productivity creator content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Branch says it partners with 'leading publications and voices' and offers a dedicated manager, but no structured UGC/ambassador program was found.
reasons.compensation: 5% per sale on CJ with a 30-day cookie; modest percentage but average order values above $400 make per-sale earnings meaningful.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate page on the brand's own site with a direct CJ sign-up route and a named program manager offer.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via CJ Affiliate linked from the brand's own page.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC office-furniture brand selling to consumers and corporate teams.

name: Drowsy
description: Sleep accessories brand (Drowsy Sleep Co) best known for its padded silk sleep mask that blocks 100% of light, plus silk pillowcases and sleep sprays, sold through its own UK and US online stores.

evidence.summary: Drowsy LLC's Awin merchant profile (fetched) states '15% commission on every sale', a 30-day cookie duration, 3.8% store conversion rate and ~$100 average order value; coupon/discount sites are not allowed on the program.
LinkClicky lists Drowsy's affiliate program at 15% per sale with a 30-day cookie (via ShareASale), corroborating the 15% rate on a second network.

Drowsy's own affiliate terms (fetched) define the affiliate's services as creating and posting original photo, video and/or written content promoting Drowsy products and sharing a personal promo code — a creator-content program, paid monthly on net sales.

Drowsy's official Instagram account @drowsysleepco (71K followers) actively promotes the silk sleep mask line; the Awin profile describes a large beauty-sector customer base buying for sleep problems, upgrades and gifting.
Neither the Awin profile nor Drowsy's affiliate terms state an earnings cap, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: A hero sleep product at the center of the TikTok/Instagram sleep-hack and night-routine niche, with a beauty crossover.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own affiliate terms require original photo/video content creation, and its Instagram actively drives creator-style mask content.
reasons.compensation: A flat published 15% commission on every sale (Awin profile), with ~$100 average order value.
reasons.contact_access: Network application route plus published affiliate terms on the brand's own site; no public email found.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open on Awin (and listed on ShareASale), though coupon sites are excluded.
reasons.credibility: Established sleep brand (Drowsy Sleep Co Ltd / Drowsy LLC) with 71K Instagram followers and press coverage.

name: Revival Rugs
description: Home goods brand and marketplace selling one-of-a-kind vintage and handmade rugs sourced from makers around the world, plus washable rugs and complementary home goods, through its own online store.

evidence.summary: Revival's own Brand Ambassadors page (fetched) offers 'FREE PRODUCTS' and '10% COMMISSION' to ambassadors who apply through the page.

Revival Rugs Inc also runs an affiliate program listed on Awin (merchant profile fetched) with a 30-day attribution period; the profile describes Revival as a home goods brand and marketplace that began with handmade oriental rugs.
InfluencerRate's listing claims Revival affiliates can earn 'up to 15%' commission, which conflicts with the 10% figure on Revival's own ambassador page; the brand's own published 10% governs.
No earnings-cap statement appears on the ambassador page or the Awin profile, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Statement rugs and room transformations are core home-decor creator content, and washable rugs target pet-owning households.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A named Brand Ambassador program on the brand's own site offering free product plus commission, alongside heavy creator content around its rugs on social media.
reasons.compensation: 10% commission per the brand's own ambassador page, plus free products; a third-party 'up to 15%' claim conflicts and is not used.
reasons.contact_access: Public ambassador application page on the official site.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Ambassador applications open on the brand's site; a parallel affiliate listing runs on Awin.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC home-goods brand and marketplace with a globally distributed sourcing team.

name: Gravity Blankets
description: Sleep brand that popularized the weighted blanket, selling weighted blankets in 15/20/25 lb weights plus cooling covers, sleep masks and other rest accessories through its own online store.

evidence.summary: Lasso's Gravity Blankets listing (fetched) gives a 3% per-sale commission and a 45-day cookie, and its join link routes to account.shareasale.com, confirming the program runs on ShareASale.
An independent affiliate review independently reports the same Gravity Blanket terms: 3% commission and a 45-day tracking cookie.
No earnings-cap statement is published in the program listing, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Weighted blankets are a recurring sleep and anxiety-relief topic for home and wellness creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: No creator or ambassador program evidence found — a standard network affiliate program only.
reasons.compensation: A low published 3% per-sale rate, partly offset by a long 45-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator contact found; application is through ShareASale only.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to ShareASale publishers with approval.
reasons.credibility: The category-defining weighted-blanket brand with national retail and press presence.

name: Hydrow
description: Connected fitness brand selling premium indoor rowing machines (Hydrow Arc, Wave and Pro) with immersive on-water workout content and a membership, sold through its own online store.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's directory lists Hydrow's affiliate program on the Impact platform at 1%-2% commission per sale.

Published Hydrow rates conflict across directories: Lasso's 'Hydrow US Preferred' listing says 1% per sale, LinkClicky says 1%-2%, and Shopper's partnership page says up to 4% — so no single rate is recorded and commission_rate is null.
Hydrow sells connected rowing machines offering an immersive on-water experience for at-home fitness. No earnings-cap statement is published in any listing, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Premium connected rowers are a fixture of home-gym and fitness-tech creator content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: No creator or ambassador program evidence found — a standard network affiliate program only.
reasons.compensation: Published rates conflict (1% to 4% across directories) and sit at the low end even at the top figure, so no rate is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator contact found; the route is the Impact network listing.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Listed for Impact publishers; exact terms are set inside the network.
reasons.credibility: Well-known US connected-fitness brand with national retail presence.

name: Food52
description: Food media community and shop founded in 2009, built around a community of millions of home cooks, selling curated cookware, dinnerware, pantry goods and home accessories through its online shop.

evidence.summary: Bootstrapped Ventures' affiliate guide states the Food52 affiliate program is hosted on Partnerize at 9% standard commission with a 7-day cookie, and that a separate Food52 Curator creator program runs through Captiv8 at 12% on the first $100,000 of sales and 15% above that.

Published Food52 rates conflict: Lasso and Commission Academy report a 6% base commission while several other guides report 9% on Partnerize — so no single standard rate is recorded and commission_rate is null.

Vendo's program summary describes the Food52 affiliate/creator offer as including a customizable digital storefront for showcasing favorite products, recipes and stories, plus invitations to events at Food52's Brooklyn headquarters.

CyberNaira describes Food52 as a community of over 13 million cooks, recipe makers and food content editors selling kitchen tools, food and gifts. No earnings-cap statement is published for the program, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Kitchenware, tableware and pantry goods curated for exactly the food-creator audience.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A community-built brand with a dedicated Curator creator program offering personal storefronts, on top of the standard affiliate program.
reasons.compensation: Standard Partnerize rates conflict across sources (6% vs 9%), so no rate is recorded; the selective Curator tier is reported at 12-15%.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through Partnerize (standard) and Captiv8 (Curator); no public creator email found.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Standard program open on Partnerize; the higher-paying Curator program is a separate creator application.
reasons.credibility: Long-running US food media brand with a community reported at 13M+ cooks and a Brooklyn headquarters.

name: PitPat
description: UK pet-tech brand selling the PitPat dog GPS tracker and activity monitor — collar-mounted devices that track a dog's location, exercise, rest, weight and calories through an app — through its own online store.

evidence.summary: PitPat's Awin programme profile (fetched) states affiliates 'Earn up to 10% commission per sale' with quick payments, weekly validation and a 30-day cookie, UK sign-ups only, and publishes the contact affiliates@pitpatpet.com.

PitPat's own Affiliate Publisher Terms (fetched, Pitpatpet Ltd, Cambridge, UK) confirm the programme runs through an affiliate network, pays commission on approved direct-to-consumer sales within a 30-day cookie, and excludes commercial/reseller sales.

PitPat's official Instagram (@pitpatpet, 37K followers) ran a 'UGC Rep Search' recruiting dog-owner content creators, with rep benefits including gifted items, a commission scheme, an exclusive rep community and launch sneak peeks.
The Awin profile publishes only a ceiling ('up to 10%') with no base rate, so commission_rate is null; no earnings-cap statement is made, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Dog GPS and activity tracking is highly demonstrable pet-tech content for dog creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand publicly recruited UGC reps on Instagram with gifted product and a commission scheme, beyond its standard Awin programme.
reasons.compensation: Awin publishes only an 'up to 10%' ceiling with no base rate, so no rate is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: A published affiliate contact email (affiliates@pitpatpet.com) on the Awin profile, plus full programme terms on the brand's own site.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open on Awin but restricted to UK sign-ups only.
reasons.credibility: Established UK pet-tech company (Pitpatpet Ltd, Cambridge) with 37K Instagram followers.

name: PetLink
description: Pet safety brand with 30+ years in pet identification, selling microchips, QR tags and the PetLinkGPS dog tracker and activity monitor (live location, geofence alerts, activity tracking) through its online store.

evidence.summary: PetLink's Awin (US) merchant profile (fetched) publishes a '20% Standard Commission' (5% for coupon/discount sites) calculated on the final transaction amount excluding VAT and shipping, a 30-day cookie, and an average order value of $99.

The profile states PetLink has been in pet safety for over 30 years, launched its GPS product in 2024, is growing its direct-to-consumer offering with 'growing volumes of sales each month', and offers a reactive account manager and private commission rates for valuable exposure.
No earnings-cap statement appears in the Awin profile, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown; the GPS line's 2024 launch is noted but is not, by itself, evidence of low creator saturation.

reasons.niche_fit: GPS pet tracking (lost-dog recovery, geofence alerts, activity) is demonstrable, story-driven pet content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: No creator or ambassador program evidence found — a standard network affiliate program, though the brand invites tailored partnership proposals.
reasons.compensation: A strong published 20% standard commission on Awin with a $99 average order value and 30-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: Awin application route; the profile offers a reactive account manager and invites private-rate proposals, but no public email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open on Awin (US) with the brand actively pushing direct-to-consumer growth since the 2024 GPS launch.
reasons.credibility: Pet-identification brand claiming 30+ years in pet safety, now expanding into GPS trackers.
